title: assays.json
description: The dictionary that gives each assay its label, units, direction and category. anti_target_of is what drives the selectivity plot automatically.

short.description: Column header text: must fit a narrow table column.

direction.description: Per assay, never inferred from the category: a cellular counter-screen is a potency-shaped assay where higher is better.

is_primary.description: Marks the potency axis for this paper. Exactly one assay per paper may set it.

anti_target_of.description: The target assay this one counter-screens.

of_assay.description: For a published fold column, the absolute assay it was computed from.
